static_traits.name: Chen An
static_traits.social_status: 与同事的关系因Persistent anxiety和Self-doubt而紧张；有几位亲密朋友但not yet与其讨论工作相关Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑性较好，能自我觉察与Reflection；配合度高、态度积极；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在经历与工作相关演示的强烈Anxiety，认为它们很糟糕，并担心因此丢掉工作。这种恐惧始于一年前我在一次演示后收到建设性反馈。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，是因为这种Anxiety正在影响我的工作表现和整体幸福感；我需要帮助弄清如何应对并开发实际的应对策略。
growth_experiences: 一年前在一次工作演示后收到建设性反馈，自此开始将反馈与失败相连；每逢演示前频繁出现灾难化与过度思考，Anxiety逐步升级并影响睡眠、饮食、工作表现与同事关系。
父母已去世、Living alone；虽有几位亲密朋友，但not yet向他们谈及工作相关Anxiety，社会支持的利用度较低。

core_beliefs: I am incompetent（如果not完美就会被视为not称职）

special_situations.event: 获知即将进行工作演示/汇报
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果任何细节not完美，所有人都会注意到缺陷，老板会认为我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前Over-preparation、反复检查每个细节，并尝试积极自我对话与放松练习
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次演示很糟糕，我会丢掉工作

special_situations.event: 在一次演示后收到建设性反馈
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I receive criticism, it means I performed poorly and I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher perfection standards, doubles demands on herself to avoid being criticized again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我很差劲，我失败了

special_situations.event: 演示结束后的自我评估与Reflection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果演示not完美，我终将失去工作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes in the mind, ignores positive or neutral feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这次搞砸了，我要被解雇

special_situations.event: 在演示前后与同事互动
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not够好，同事会认为我without能并疏远我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication, appears distant or irritable to avoid talking about the presentation

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to have work value seen, to keep job security and be regarded as competent
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败、被评判为without能、失去工作
defense_goal: 通过完美主义与Over-preparation来避免失败与批评
Avoids expressing vulnerability to others to avoid being seen as complaining

object_relations.self_representation: 可能not称职、容易被批评的员工
孤立的演讲者（需要独自承受）
object_relations.object_representation: Distant others (friends/colleagues, hard to provide support or avoided by me)

manifestations: not yet向亲密朋友谈及工作Anxiety
outcomes: 在演示前后体验到加剧的Anxiety与without助感
社会支持难以获得，压力感提升

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将“必须完美”“not完美等于失败”内化为自我标准
Treats others' expectations as one's own absolute criterion to constrain performance

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: 担心“会给朋友添麻烦/像在抱怨”，因此not向朋友谈及工作Anxiety
将外在压力Turning against the self，表现为胸口紧绷、头痛等身体紧张

positive_force: 具备自我觉察，能辨认反馈是建设性的而非negate
Positive attitude, high cooperation, willing to practice thought records and reality testing
Has several close friends; potential social support resources exist
Have tried relaxation and positive self-talk, with a certain coping foundation
稳定的教育与工作背景（工商管理学士，Office work）
negative_force: 完美主义倾向与对失败的恐惧
灾难化、预测not yet来、过度概括、非黑即白等认知偏差
演示前后过度思考与生理性Anxiety（心跳加速、出汗、胃部紧绷、头痛）
睡眠与饮食被干扰，专注度下降，Work performance affected
Tense relationships with colleagues，避免向朋友寻求支持

target_behavior.behavior: 工作演示/汇报前的强烈Anxiety与过度思考（伴随明显生理症状）
antecedent: 获知即将进行演示/汇报
演示结束后的自我评估
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionism and fear of failure，将建设性反馈视为威胁，并以灾难化与预测not yet来的方式Anticipation最坏结果
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在失败与负面评价，通过Over-preparation和自我控制来寻求安全感与确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet disturbance、Decreased attention、Work performance affected、Tense relationships with colleagues
